dossier.novelty_summary: Novelty remains a research hypothesis until verified literature comparison and the declared experiments are complete.
dossier.title: SynthSEA research-to-publication dossier

hypotheses: The full pipeline will improve at least one predeclared quality measure without unacceptable safety or cultural regressions.
research_questions.question: Does coordinated language-aware synthetic instruction generation improve quality over declared baselines?

hypotheses: Removing language-aware, cultural, or verification components will change predeclared outcomes.
research_questions.question: Which components of SynthSEA account for observed quality differences?

hypotheses: Performance and failure patterns will differ by language setting and must not be hidden by aggregate scores.
research_questions.question: How do quality, safety, and cultural judgments vary across the four target settings?
